draft.answer: The records combine to report 12 × 8 = 96 units shipped and 96 − 3 = 93 usable units. These are records-based figures. They establish actual shipment and usable counts only if the dispatch and packing records accurately describe this shipment and the receiving record accurately identifies the complete set of unusable units from it; that accuracy is not established by the supplied sources.
